scope.unrun_reason: Seven balanced cases satisfy the requested five-to-ten-case study. Optional case 1799 admission stopped after the active trial finished to prioritize memory repair; no completed result was discarded.
scope.direction_worker: One cold process per case, direction, seed count and cache setting.
scope.cache_reuse_scope: Within one direction, across its seeds and cuts; no imported or shared persistent cache.
scope.cache_off_scope: Disables completed-fragment result retention; other preparation and symmetry work remain enabled.
scope.reference_policy: exact heavy-atom relation including unmatched atoms, modulo endpoint chemical symmetry
scope.timing_scope: Matching CPU is separate from preparation, symmetry finalization, family reduction, verification and audit. Summed direction wall times are not parallel reaction latency.
scope.memory_scope: Whole-worker sampled and process-lifetime peaks include fingerprint auditing and verification, not matching alone. Actual memory guards are recorded per task.
scope.memory_protocol_update: 105 completed tasks used 4 GiB/600 s guards; 12 further settings used 16 GiB/1800 s after normal draining. No completed task was repeated and no guard was reached. One cache pair (709, five seeds, forward) has different inactive guards. Scientific settings and the 64 MiB fragment-cache budget are unchanged.
scope.fingerprint_scope: V1 and V2 audit implementations share scientific source/configuration. Signatures are compared only within matching versions. Audit CPU is separate; its allocations can affect whole-worker time and RSS.

timing_overlap.interpretation: Only this unpaired extra cell overlapped. Its timing is not an isolated-host comparison. All fixed-cohort trials and the case 1799 one-seed pairs preceded this interval.
